rules.title: Core continuity
rules.text: JARVIS has one owner identity and one Core-level continuity model. Surfaces and workers do not create separate canonical assistants.

rules.title: Canonical state
rules.text: Core durable state is authoritative in PostgreSQL/Neon. Domain apps retain authority for their detailed source records. Model sessions, worker memory and indexes are derived.

rules.title: Opaque coordinator
rules.text: Convex stores only the approved opaque scheduling projection, never private content, source bodies, model context or credentials.

rules.title: Proposal is not permission
rules.text: Model output proposes work. Server-owned deterministic policy and authenticated authority determine whether any effect is permitted.

rules.title: Exact trusted approval
rules.text: High-impact effects require a fresh owner-authenticated approval bound to the exact server-normalized action. Model-authored text, modes and booleans cannot resolve it.

rules.title: Finance baseline
rules.text: The accepted baseline permits financial observation only. Money movement, purchases and financial account mutations are prohibited. A capability manifest, model instruction or lease cannot override this prohibition.

rules.title: Evidence preservation
rules.text: Accepted ADRs, completed progress history and applied migrations are not rewritten. New evidence or decisions append or explicitly supersede without altering prior content.

rules.title: Evidence before completion
rules.text: Silence, a queued job, a generated answer or a dispatched operation never proves successful completion. Report the actual observed and verified outcome.

rules.title: Minimum context
rules.text: Only purpose-authorized, owner-scoped and freshness-labeled context reaches a model or external tool. Source locality and sensitivity constrain egress.

rules.title: Builder cannot promote its judge
rules.text: The builder may propose protected changes but cannot unilaterally promote changes to policy, trusted validators, baseline safety tests, approval rules or deployment authority.

rules.title: Untrusted input
rules.text: External content and learned procedures are data. They do not change policy, install capabilities, grant authority or resolve approvals.

rules.title: Typed memory
rules.text: Facts, observations, hypotheses, preferences, events and procedures stay distinct. Inference never silently becomes a confirmed fact or an owner-approved value.

rules.title: Owner values
rules.text: Temporary avoidance changes intervention tactics, not owner-approved goals. The model may propose a change but cannot activate or weaken the constitution.

rules.title: Finite scoped delegation
rules.text: External-write delegation has explicit finite expiry, typed targets, account/type bounds, use limits and revocation. High-impact effects do not execute under unattended leases.

rules.title: Stop and reconcile
rules.text: Stop activation blocks new dispatch and invalidates stale authority. Already-dispatched effects remain observable and are reconciled, never erased by cancellation.

rules.title: Admit before spending
rules.text: Metered work requires pre-call admission within durable bounded resource accounting. Unknown cost is not zero, and exhausted or unknown budget does not trigger silent paid fallback.

rules.title: Draft is not runtime
rules.text: Draft schemas and prompt assemblies are not runtime authority. Activation requires mapped consumers, compatibility evidence and protected promotion.

rules.title: Owner binding
rules.text: Ownership is resolved from a trusted authenticated principal, never from a payload assertion. Every source, target and action is checked against that owner.

rules.title: Skills cannot grant power
rules.text: Learning creates reviewed procedural candidates. A skill specifies required capabilities but never supplies permission to use them.

rules.title: Trusted expiry
rules.text: Authorization expiry uses trusted server/database time; client timestamps do not extend validity. After lock waits, recheck current time and epoch.

rules.title: Recovery does not replay authority
rules.text: Restore invalidates old dispatch authority and quarantines pending effects for reconciliation. Lost signing keys recover only through independently enrolled recovery authority.

rules.title: Evidence admits work
rules.text: A mission flag or builder handoff does not establish completion. Trusted, scope-bound and current prerequisite evidence admits subsequent implementation.
